visual_findings: Measured/mechanical: every sampled Working cell I viewed matches the operation's recorded frame index by byte identity: frame-0 samples, wrap samples and all reduced/initially-reduced samples share sha256 e4f2737d... (1x) / ecc4d147... (3x); frames 1-3 have their own stable hashes across normal-start and normal-restored.

Visually inspected: the four Working frames read as one segmented ring stepping clockwise; 3x captures are crisp nearest-neighbour blocks with no smoothing; statusCell and compactStatus produce byte-identical cells at each scale.

Visually inspected: in both reduced screenshots the live Working row shows the frame-0 glyph (the consumer's held cell); in both normal screenshots the live row shows a different rotation phase from the matrix frame 0. This is consistent with the counts but is a single still per phase, not playback evidence.
No artistic judgment, continuity or distinction verdict is made here; those criteria keep their existing historical verdicts and were not re-reviewed.
